additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0404405 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
MAYBE
Onsite Troubleshooting
YES
End Customer Communication
YES
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Based on the active error flags in the SCB and using SSH access, we found that there is an issue with the wiring, as it is showing 0 ohms for temp. sensors. To address this issue, a site visit is required. Please also carry a spare StateMonitor_KF13 with you
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
